Initial purchasers were granted an option to acquire up to an additional $20M in principal amount within a 13-day period.
The transaction settlement is expected on September 15, 2026.

Notes will bear interest at 7.00% per annum, payable semi-annually on March 15 and September 15, starting March 15, 2027. The notes mature on September 15, 2030, unless earlier repurchased, redeemed, or converted.

The initial conversion rate is 204.0608 shares per $1,000 principal amount (equivalent to ~$4.90 per share), representing a 35.0% premium over Redwood’s September 10, 2026 closing price. Conversion value up to principal will be paid in cash, with any excess settled in cash or stock.
Redwood retains the right to redeem the notes in whole or in part prior to maturity to preserve its REIT tax status.

Redwood Trust plans to allocate approximately $129.29M of the net proceeds to repurchase $123.79M aggregate principal amount of its 7.75% convertible senior notes due 2027 in privately negotiated transactions.

Additionally, the company will deploy roughly $20M to concurrently repurchase 5,509,641 shares of its common stock. The remaining proceeds are designated for general corporate purposes, such as supporting its mortgage banking channels (Sequoia, Aspire, and CoreVest), acquiring portfolio assets for Redwood Investments, and funding prospective strategic acquisitions.
